correctness.rationale: Gradient and Euler equations classify all projective critical points. The exact binary-cubic discriminant and Gröbner eliminant agree; twelve squarefree roots give two singular points each. Rank-three Hessians and x3^3 show A2 with Milnor number two, and the nonzero parameter derivative gives local discriminant multiplicity two each. Cyclotomic identification and irreducibility mod 2 give both sextic Galois orbits, with the real-embedding argument proving the 6+6+12 point-orbit partition. All required calculations were independently replayed from verify.py.

value.rationale: The paper studies the smooth Prym-bearing Eckardt sections; determining their complete boundary is a natural geometric task. The exact twelve exceptional fibers, two A2 singularities each, nonreduced fourth-power discriminant and Galois orbit distribution form a structural complete classification of an explicitly motivated special smooth fourfold, identifying arithmetic fields and local deformation behavior beyond the general dual-degree identity.
